title: Staged Semantic Distillation: Preserving Free-Form Semantics in a Low-Compute Non-LLM Surrogate of a Staged LLM Agent
abstract: arXiv:2611.19299v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Staged LLM agents make market and social simulators realistic, but one 102-day run of a 200-agent, ten-index market simulator issues 203,100 language-model calls and returns one realization. Conventional low-compute distillation drops their free-form intermediate state. We present staged semantic distillation, a low-compute method that preserves non-structured semantics in a non-LLM student trained from one recorded trace. A frozen encoder maps each teacher output to a 1024-d vector; the student sees typed stage-tagged vectors with stage-specific visibility, is jointly supervised, and trains with scheduled self-history. One TwinMarket trace yields a 13.2M-parameter deterministic student that trains in 1,658 seconds on one 8-GB GPU and runs with zero teacher or decoder calls and no text generation (0.14 ms per decision). translated_title: 分阶段语义蒸馏：在分阶段LLM智能体的低算力非LLM代理中保留自由形式语义
translated_abstract: 分阶段LLM智能体使市场与社交模拟器更加真实，但一次由200个智能体、十个指数组成的市场模拟器运行102天需要发出203,100次语言模型调用，且仅返回一种实现结果。传统的低算力蒸馏会丢失其自由形式的中间状态。我们提出分阶段语义蒸馏——一种低算力方法，可在由单条记录轨迹训练的非LLM学生模型中保留非结构化语义。冻结编码器将每个教师输出映射为1024维向量；学生模型接收带类型、带阶段标签且具有阶段特定可见性的向量，接受联合监督，并通过调度的自历史进行训练。一条TwinMarket轨迹即可训练出1320万参数的确定性学生模型，在单块8-GB GPU上1658秒内完成训练，运行时无需任何教师或解码器调用、无需文本生成（每次决策0.14毫秒）。其分析结果与教师保持高度接近（余弦相似度0.943），且在智能体之间交换语义输入会改变64.7%的决策……
tldr: 该论文提出“分阶段语义蒸馏”方法，仅凭一条记录轨迹即可训练出1320万参数的非LLM学生代理，在单块8-GB GPU上1658秒完成训练、每次决策仅需0.14毫秒，同时以余弦相似度0.943的精度保留分阶段LLM智能体的自由形式语义。
en_tdlr: Staged semantic distillation trains a 13.2M-parameter non-LLM surrogate from a single recorded trace of a staged LLM agent, preserving free-form semantics with cosine similarity 0.943 while training in 1,658 seconds on one 8-GB GPU and running at 0.14 ms per decision with zero teacher or decoder calls.
